civilopediaText.text: A universe of slippery cons, high-tech heists, and minor local friction. You'll survive by your wits and a cheeky grin.
Tactical simulations and military academy pressures. The stakes are global, and the commanders are brilliant children.
Vengeful AI warships waking up in a dark empire to settle an ancient, bloody score. The galaxy burned once; it's about to happen again.
